notes:
Quick notes from calls & POC. Shorthand.
- Org: 250 engineers + content ops; single central archive (~50M items after deduping).
- Problem: search precision degrades on long-form pieces (10-200 pages, long transcripts). Users expect context-aware results and reranking to move exact excerpt matches up.
- Current stack: ElasticSearch for metadata + candidate retrieval, Postgres for metadata joins, experiments with FAISS for vectors.
- POC setup: two-stage retrieval: sparse BM25 -> ANN embedding recall -> cross-encoder rerank. Default embedder: OpenAI-style dense embedder (customer also testing open-source M-Embed).
- Chunking: customer tried static 512-token chunks; observed cross-chunk context loss. Asking about adaptive chunking by semantic boundaries (scene/section markers) and overlapping windows (20% overlap). Also exploring hierarchical chunks: short chunks for retrieval + long-window context for reranker input.
- Reranker: tested twin-stage with DistilCross + full cross-encoder. Full cross-encoder gives best quality but p99 latency 410ms on CPU; target p99 <= 200ms. Want GPU-hosted reranker in Dedicated or Private.
- Indexing scale: 50M documents -> ~250M chunks (avg 5 chunks/doc). Need sharding plan, index compaction, and quantized PQ for memory. Concern: realtime ingest + reranking for editorial workflows.
- Latency/throughput: editorial queries ~200 qps peak (batching windows allowed). Soft SLO: p50 < 75ms, p99 < 200ms. Cost sensitivity: ~$0.0025 per query target for long-term.
- Fallbacks & reliability: prefer graceful degradation to faster sparse-only pipeline when reranker unavailable. Want canary rollouts for reranker model swaps.
- Security: must support SAML SSO, KMS for keys, audit logs for query-level access, and EU residency for archive subset.
- Quote from Head of Search: "We need relevant paragraphs, not just file-level hits — reranker has to understand sections."
- Next POC steps: tune ANN recall (ef/search), experiment with PQ sizes, test 2-stage caching (prefix & top-k cache), run 10k query eval set for reg metrics.
- Docs: uploaded sample eval set to Drive; security docs in SEC-1170 ticket; Fireflies links for call transcripts.
